thread:
julia (solutions): Quick sync — OrionHealth POC timeline + owners. They want a working end-to-end demo by 3/31, success criteria = <200ms median gen for 1k tokens, PHI-safe routing + audit logs. Can owners confirm dependencies and blockers?

matt (eng): I can own the inference side (model pinning + canary). Blocker: need their sample EHR dataset and schema by 3/18 so I can profile seq lengths.

arjun (acct-exec): Followed up with their SRE this morning, they said dataset delivery by end of day Friday (3/14). I'll ping again.

samira (se): I can take integration + onboarding. Need network access: VPC peering or private link? Also need the auth flow spec (token vs mTLS).

julia (solutions): @samira good point — Orion asked for Private deployment for compliance. Kate, is private control-plane test env ready for them?

kate (product): We have a staging private cluster but it needs an RBAC role for the customer tenant. Ops can spin it up, but we need an owner for TLS certs.

kevin (sre): I can provision the RBAC + certs, but need the intended domain name and a contact on their side for CA pinning. Also we'll need audit-log retention set to 1y — confirm that is desired.

arjun (acct-exec): I'll get the domain and CA contact. Audit retention 1y is what their compliance asked for.

matt (eng): From infra side there are a few items: (1) model variant with quantization Q4 (we'll test Q3 if latency too high), (2) KV cache warmup plan, (3) mock traffic generator for load tests. I can create PRs for (2) and (3) once dataset profile is in.

samira (se): For the auth flow, Orion prefers mTLS. We have a short checklist I can share — includes client cert, CRL setup, and SPNEGO headers for proxy. Posting snippet for quick test they can run:

```bash
curl --cert client.crt --key client.key -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://private-api.orion.example.com/health
```

julia (solutions): Re milestones:
- 3/14: dataset + domain from Orion (arjun)
- 3/16: SRE certs + RBAC (kevin)
- 3/18: eng profiling + batch config (matt)
- 3/22: integration smoke + auth test (samira)
- 3/26: canary deploy + perf test (matt/kevin)
- 3/31: demo/hand-off to Orion (julia)

Please reply with thumbs up and add any missing deps.

kevin (sre): +1 on dates. One more: need approval for increased log retention (storage cost). I'll open a small change request in finance.

arjun (acct-exec): thumbs up. I'll escalate dataset if we miss EOD Friday.

matt (eng): FYI opened two PRs: #482 (kv-cache warmup) and #483 (local load-gen harness). PTAL @samira for test scenarios.

samira (se): Looking now. For the load-gen, can you add a mode that replays large prefix tokens? Their EHR payloads have long notes (avg ~1.2k tokens).

matt (eng): Yep — adding a --long-prefix flag. Will push an update by EOD.

julia (solutions): Action items recap:
- arjun: dataset + domain (due 3/14)
- kevin: RBAC + certs + CR change request (due 3/16)
- matt: profiling + PR updates (due 3/18)
- samira: auth checklist + integration tests (due 3/22)
- kate: confirm private staging tenant config (ASAP)

If anything slips, call out blockers here and we'll re-plan. :eyes:

devops-bot: Deployment window reserved 3/25-3/27 for canary.

kate (product): Confirmed staging tenant config — need to add the Orion contact email to the tenant.

arjun (acct-exec): Added contact (sre-orion@orionhealth.com). Dataset still on track.

matt (eng): Quick note for reviewers: PR #482 includes this test command for the load generator:

```bash
python loadgen.py --rate 100 --duration 600 --mode replay --dataset orion_sample.json
```

samira (se): Got it. I'll start integration tests once the domain TLS is in place.

julia (solutions): Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the POC tracker doc and ping execs if dates move.

kevin (sre): FYI if audit retention needs legal sign-off we should surface ASAP. Opening ticket now.

matt (eng): Small ask — any chance we can get a short list of priority endpoints they want to demo? That helps with model prompt tuning.

arjun (acct-exec): I'll ask product on their side and report back by 3/15.

julia (solutions): Perfect. We'll reconvene async here. :thumbsup:
